description: Gaunt, four-horned, snow to the claws. The wings never beat. Two colours on it are wrong, and both are hot.
lore: Snow-coloured from the crest to the claws, so the first thing anybody sees of one is its eyes. It comes on its feet, wings held open and never once beaten, and makes no sound at all on the snow, and it does not stop hunting, because there is almost nothing up there to catch and nothing in it that could ever be full. What the claws open does not close; the cold moves into the wound and settles.

The trouble is not what it is. The trouble is where it is. The high snow lies a great many days uphill, on the far side of the massif from [[lore/the_hole_under_the_mountain|the mouth]], over country more of the dead have agreed on, for longer, than any other ground in the world. People called it safe on exactly that reasoning: too well remembered to lose.

[[characters/a6d7323d|Gunnar]] came down off that country in spring with his survey unfinished, which no one had known him to do. He had found talon sockets in the drift, ragged, in matched sets, a whole season's line of them, and he had taken a bearing along the line. The sockets are on his map now. The bearing he keeps where he keeps most of what the ground has been doing lately — to himself — and the people who trust Gunnar's silences have started going the long way west.
gm_notes: This record's job is dread of spread: the emptying is not staying at the mouth. Gunnar's withheld bearing stays withheld — where the line points is GM territory, and naming it would spend cave material a leaf has no business spending.
